description: Custom ECL queries for Nitrite in Urine (LOINC 32710-6)
_loinc_survey_doc: LOINC-side recall survey (Loinc.csv of the pinned LOINC release): regexes on COMPONENT / PROPERTY / SYSTEM that select the LOINC terms a laboratory physician would count as this analyte (CLASSTYPE 1, not DEPRECATED). The generator reports how many of them the LOINC Ontology pool reaches.

queries.name: Refined Query V2 Quantitative (Measurement Properties)
queries.description: Uses Component = Nitrite salt AND Property = Measurement property (universal parent of quantitative types) for quantitative nitrite measurements. This captures substance concentration, molar concentration, and other quantitative measurements in urine.

queries.name: Refined Query V2 Qualitative (Presence or Threshold Properties)
queries.description: Uses Component = Nitrite salt AND Property = Presence (705057003) OR Threshold (118589004) for qualitative nitrite detection. LOINC Ontology 2026-10-21 remodelled the dipstick observables from Presence to Threshold (a Measurement property with Ordinal scale); the OR keeps the query comparable across releases. This captures presence/absence tests commonly used in urinalysis dipstick tests.
